artifacts.summary: Confirms the H1 selector defect at orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh:2453 (grep|head -1 over PHASE_STATUS_OPEN_ERE, no Depends-on awareness, BLOCKED overloaded between two meanings); establishes that COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS already closes the dynamic-bypass disposition case so no new prose signal is needed; finds phase-level Depends on: is prose-only with no existing parser and documents its absence-means-all-priors default; locates the Group 9 H1 test suite in test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh as the exact home for new fixtures; recommends a new narrower PHASE_STATUS_ENTERABLE alternation plus Depends-on-closure check, and a distinct new blocked-reason for the no-enterable-phase case.

memory_candidates.content: In this codebase's plan-format.md, [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] already closes the 'decision gate executed, failed, contingency branch ran instead' case for bypassed phases, and is already a member of PHASE_STATUS_DONE_ALT (excluded from PHASE_STATUS_OPEN_ALT). A SEPARATE, legitimate use of [BLOCKED] at the phase-heading grain exists for a gate that is pre-decided BLOCKED at plan-authoring time (never executes) -- it declares Depends on: none and is exempted from the transitive dependency rule, with the final phase re-observing its measurement instead. Both meanings share the identical [BLOCKED] marker text with no textual way to distinguish them; any selector logic should simply treat [BLOCKED] as universally non-enterable rather than trying to disambiguate the two meanings.

Phase-level '**Depends on:**' lines in this codebase's plan files (distinct from task-level dependencies[] in state.json) are prose-only today -- no script in scripts/ or scripts/lib/ parses them. Documented default when the field is absent: 'depends on all prior phases' (full sequential), not 'no dependency'. A future consumer must implement this parser from scratch and must honor the absence default or it will under-gate plans relying on it. PHASE_NUMBER_TOKEN_ERE in phase-heading-patterns.sh is the existing per-token number grammar to reuse for validating comma-split dependency tokens.
